title: Do Firms Strategically Internalize Disclosure Spillovers? Evidence from Cash-Financed M&As

dependency_review.description: SAS Step 1 reads the SDC M&A input. The only local SDC candidate is mapped but lacks the author-added PERMNO variables; route and identifiers remain unresolved.
SAS Step 1 joins the SharkWatch deal/activism table on deal_num.
WORK.KVY_CASH is created from the filtered SDC sample and activism join, then uploaded at Step 2; it is generated, not a missing external file.
RSUBMIT reads remote COMP.FUNDA with the listed annual fundamentals/filter fields.
Remote WORK.FUNDA1 is produced from filtered COMP.FUNDA at SAS line 136 and consumed by the next link-history step.
Remote WORK.FUNDA2 is produced from FUNDA1 joined to the CCM link history with date and link-type criteria.
Remote WORK.FIRM_AGE_TEMP is created from target PERMNOs and CRSP.MSF, then supplies each deal’s first available monthly date.
Remote CRSP.MSF supplies target firm-age and 1-year return construction; a local common candidate exists, but code uses remote CRSP.MSF and coverage is unverified.
SAS Step 3 reads the author-format BEA-to-NAICS crosswalk.
SAS Step 3 reads the author-format 2007 BEA industry input-output table.
SAS Steps 4-5 read CRSP daily stock returns; local CRSP.DSF is a readable matching product candidate with coverage still unverified.
SAS Steps 4-5 read CRSP daily index value-weighted returns; local CRSP.DSI candidate has expected columns with date coverage unverified.
SAS Step 6 unconditionally reads the precomputed US_public_earncorr table; no producer program is supplied.
SAS Step 7 reads RavenPack PR Edition, not Full Edition.
SAS Step 8 reads article-level Factiva text results for daily aggregation.
Stata’s data/kvy_cash.dta is produced by SAS PROC EXPORT after Steps 1-8; the known output-root/extension mapping is a routine working-copy configuration.
bidder_disc_temp1.dta is written by Stata Step 9 at line 29 and is consumed by Step 10; it is not an external input.
bidder_disc_temp2.dta is written by Stata Step 10 at line 82 and is consumed by Step 11.
bidder_disc_rank.dta is written by Stata Step 11 at line 102 and is consumed by its following collapse/merge/group steps; Step 11 also creates bidder_disc_ret_std.dta before that merge.
bidder_disc_temp3.dta is written by Stata Step 11 at line 130 and consumed by Step 12; the final output bidder_disc.dta is saved at line 166.

If using local SDC.WRDS_MA_DETAILS, map only source columns confirmed by its one-row probe and provide a documented PERMNO crosswalk with deal-date logic; do not guess links from CUSIP/name or infer unobserved author fields.

Treat deal_value_dollars, num_bidders, deal flags, cyear, and announcement-relative date fields as generated from SDC source columns/dates; activism is joined from the separate SharkWatch input, not requested as an SDC column.
validation: Check the exact author SDC fields, including the seven retained columns and PERMNO identifiers, against the input contract at SAS lines 123–125; then validate the 2000–2017 announcement sample and author joins before panel construction.

Confirm deal_value_dollars/num_bidders/flags/date fields are produced from their code inputs and activism is supplied by the separate SharkWatch join, rather than treating them as additional raw SDC columns.

review_notes: First expanded review checkpoint. The selected target is the actual supplied SAS preparation followed by the supplied Stata panel-construction file. The work-item dependency checklist contains 15 SAS reads plus five Stata file dependencies; all 20 IDs are now reviewed, with WORK/temp files classified as generated. The trace at probes/workflow_trace.json records the full producer-consumer sequence and input history.

The author-documented SEC Background-of-the-Merger search is not read by either supplied program. The code constructs date_negstart as 60 weekdays before announcement; the SEC narrative is contextual only for this target, not a mandatory dependency or prerequisite.

The packaged SDC CSV is identifiers only. The local SDC.WRDS_MA_DETAILS one-row schema lacks the acquirer/target PERMNO variables added to the author extract. Local COMP.FUNDA, CCMXPF_LNKHIST, MSF, DSF and DSI tables are readable candidates with row-limited probes; their history, population and code-context compatibility remain unverified.

No author code was executed and no dataset downloaded/installed. R010 US_public_earncorr has a missing separate producer, FactSet SharkWatch and Factiva-processed results are absent, RavenPack input must remain PR Edition-specific, and BEA public routes still need exact author-format mapping.

The Stata file stops after saving a constructed bidder_disc.dta. It does not estimate or export the paper tables. No compatible analysis-ready panel is packaged, so an analysis_only scope is not supported. Appendix results are contextual and do not add entry points.

The Stata helper probes find center and winsor2 unavailable in checked adopaths, while _gxtile and Stata 18 are available. SAS startup was unverified after the TKELS error; SAS/CONNECT and SAS/ACCESS Interface to PC Files also remain unverified.
